questions.question: Neither of the boys ________ willing to admit that he had broken the vase.
questions.explanation: “Neither of + 复数名词”作主语时，谓语动词通常用单数形式。句中根据过去完成时“had broken”可知语境为过去时，故选 was。

questions.question: Mrs Lee, together with her twin daughters, ________ for London tomorrow night.
questions.explanation: 当主语后接“together with / as well as / along with”等介词短语时，谓语动词的数取决于前面的主语 Mrs Lee（单数），故用单数形式 is leaving。

questions.question: He seldom goes to the cinema on weekdays, ________ he?
questions.explanation: 陈述句中含有否定副词 seldom，反义疑问句的疑问部分需用肯定形式；时态为一般现在时，主语是 he，助动词用 does。

questions.question: The students are looking forward to ________ the Science Centre next Friday.
questions.explanation: “look forward to”中的 to 为介词，后面须接动名词（V-ing），故选 visiting。

questions.question: There was ________ water left in the kettle, so we could not make any tea.
questions.explanation: water 是不可数名词，排除 few 和 a few；根据后半句“could not make any tea”可知表示几乎没有，表否定含义，故用 little。

questions.question: If you ________ your homework early, you will be allowed to play computer games.
questions.explanation: 在含有 if 引导的条件状语从句中，遵循“主将从现”原则，主句用一般将来时，从句用一般现在时表示将来，故选 finish。

questions.question: The boy ________ bicycle was stolen reported the incident to the police.
questions.explanation: 先行词为 The boy，在定语从句中充当 bicycle 的定语，表示“那个男孩的自行车”，关系代词应使用所有格 whose。

questions.question: The heavy rain caused the soccer match to be ________ until next week.
questions.explanation: “put off”表示推迟、延期；“put on”穿上/上演；“put out”熄灭；“put up”张贴/搭建。根据句意，比赛推迟到下周，故选 put off。

questions.question: Our teacher made all of us ________ the classroom before leaving for home.
questions.explanation: 使役动词 make 的常见用法为 make somebody do something（省略 to 的不定式），故选原形 sweep。

questions.question: Let's go for a cycle along the East Coast Park, ________ we?
questions.explanation: 以“Let's...”开头的祈使句，其反义疑问句固定用“shall we?”。

questions.question: Either Mr Tan or his colleagues ________ responsible for setting up the stage.
questions.explanation: “Either... or...”连接两个主语时，谓语动词遵循就近原则。离谓语最近的主语是复数 his colleagues，故使用 are。

questions.question: My grandfather ________ in this neighbourhood for over thirty years.
questions.explanation: 句中有持续时间短语“for over thirty years”，表示从过去持续到现在的动作，应用现在完成时 has lived。

questions.question: ________ the heavy traffic, we managed to arrive at the airport on time.
questions.explanation: “the heavy traffic”是名词短语，需用介词。Although 和 Even though 后面接句子，Despite 是介词，意为“尽管”，故选 Despite。

questions.question: Everyone in the audience ________ amazed by the magician's final trick.
questions.explanation: 不定代词 everyone 作主语时视作单数，结合过去语境，谓语动词应选用 was。

questions.question: By the time the firefighter arrived, the fire ________ by the neighbours.
questions.explanation: 由“By the time + 一般过去时”引导的时间状语从句可知，主句动作发生在过去某个时间之前，属于“过去的过去”，且主语 the fire 与 put out 是被动关系，用过去完成时的被动语态 had been put out。

questions.question: You ________ carry an umbrella; the weather forecast says it will be sunny all day.
questions.explanation: 根据天气预报全天晴天可知，没有必要带伞。needn't 表示“不必”；mustn't 表示“禁止”，故选 needn't。

questions.question: The librarian told the children to stop ________ and listen to instructions.
questions.explanation: stop doing sth 表示“停止正在做的事情”，stop to do sth 表示“停下来去开始做另一件事”。管理员让孩子们停止聊天，故选 chattering。

questions.question: Of the two runners, Ken is definitely the ________ one.
questions.explanation: 两者之间进行比较，应用比较级，且特指两者中“更……”的一个时，需用“the + 比较级”，故选 faster。

questions.question: Each of the winners ________ a certificate and a medal during the ceremony.
questions.explanation: “Each of + 复数名词”作主语时，谓语动词用单数形式 receives。

questions.question: Lucas was used to ________ up at six o'clock every morning to catch the school bus.
questions.explanation: “be used to doing sth”表示“习惯于做某事”，其中的 to 是介词，后面跟动名词 waking；“used to do sth”表示“过去常常”。

questions.question: She could ________ hear what the speaker said because the microphone was broken.
questions.explanation: 麦克风坏了，所以她“几乎听不到”。hardly 是具有否定意义的副词，意为“几乎不”。

questions.question: This is the very museum ________ we visited during our school excursion last year.
questions.explanation: 先行词 museum 前有 the very（正是、恰恰是）修饰时，关系代词只能用 that，而不用 which。

questions.question: I don't enjoy horror movies, and ________ does my sister.
questions.explanation: 表示“某人也不……”且前句为否定句时，使用“neither + 助动词 + 主语”结构，故选 neither。

questions.question: A swarm of bees ________ hovering over the colourful flowers in the garden.
questions.explanation: “A swarm of...”表示一群蜜蜂，作为单数集合名词短语，谓语动词应选用单数形式 was。

questions.question: Nobody called while I was out, ________?
questions.explanation: 陈述句主语是不定代词 nobody 时，疑问尾句的主语通常用 they 代替；nobody 表达否定概念，故疑问部分用肯定式 did they。

questions.question: The chef was accused ________ using expired ingredients in his signature dish.
questions.explanation: 固定短语“be accused of (doing) sth”表示“被指控/被指责做某事”，故介词选 of。

questions.question: The parcel ________ to the wrong address because the label was torn.
questions.explanation: 主语 parcel（包裹）与 deliver（递送）是被动关系，且事情发生在过去，应用一般过去时的被动语态 was delivered。

questions.question: You will not pass the swimming test ________ you practise regularly.
questions.explanation: unless 意为“除非；如果不”，相当于 if... not。全句意为“除非你经常练习，否则你无法通过游泳测试”。

questions.question: My father advised me ________ too much time playing online games.
questions.explanation: 固定句型“advise sb (not) to do sth”表示“建议某人（不要）做某事”，动词不定式的否定形式是在 to 前加 not，故选 not to spend。

questions.question: The newly opened shopping mall has ________ parking lots than the old one.
questions.explanation: parking lots 是可数名词复数，结合比较级标志词 than，修饰可数名词复数应使用 fewer（few 的比较级），不可用 less（修饰不可数名词）。
